name: connectome-pilot-v1
status: frozen at CP1, 2026-09-23; changes require a new version

graph.connectome: MaleCNS v1.0 minconf 0.5, 166,700 annotated neurons, 25,582,938 directed pairs

observation.source: fire-drone sim client/src/vision/controller.ts visionObservation (goal pilot, 83 floats)
observation.channels: see io_map.json 'channels' (goal 3, velocity 3, gravity 3, rates 3, previous_action 4, goal_confident 3, depth 64)
observation.droppedRule: depth cells no eye column views (upper-front) receive no input in ANY arm; the MLP reference also gets these inputs zeroed so every arm sees the same visual field

ioMap.eyeMap: results/connectome_flight/cp1/eye_map.json (deltaPhi 5 deg, front azimuth 0; sensitivity maps at 4 and 6 deg)

anatomical.depth: L1+L2 neurons of the columns whose viewing direction falls in the cell's half-open angular bin
anatomical.rates: haltere afferents (subclass 'haltere', 205), split into 3 disjoint random thirds
anatomical.velocity_gravity: Johnston's-organ wind/gravity neurons (subclass 'wind_gravity', 475), split into 6 disjoint random parts
anatomical.goal_previousAction: NON-BIOLOGICAL: 20 random cb_intrinsic neurons per channel

ioMap.random: same channel and readout sizes drawn uniformly from the whole graph, disjoint
ioMap.encoding: input current into neuron j of channel k = g_j * x_k, with trainable per-neuron gain g_j (initialised 1/sqrt(channel size)); readout = linear map from readout-neuron rates, trainable

dynamics.model: rate network, leak 0.65, tanh (FlyGPT G2c engine)
dynamics.ticksRule: max over channels and over real + 10 degree-rewired graphs of hops to reach 50% of the readout; performance never enters
dynamics.stateReset: at the start of every flight (bridge /reset)

weightModels.trained: every anatomical edge has a trainable signed weight, initialised N(0, 0.9^2 / in-degree) as in FlyGPT

frozenBiological.weight: synapse count x transmitter sign, fixed; only input gains and readout train

signs.dopamine|octopamine|serotonin: 0 fast weight (declared; inclusion is a sensitivity variant)

frozenBiological.globalGain: one scalar so the linearised recurrent operator's spectral radius is 0.9 at the leak-adjusted operating point; set before any flight, never from performance
frozenBiological.rewiredControls: each edge keeps its biological weight and sign on its rewired endpoint

stageAOutput.readoutTarget: 3-dim horizontal velocity correction in [-1,1], identical to V5's learned net output
stageAOutput.downstream: the authored velocity controller: in drone-env v1 VelocityResidual.control; in drone-env v2 an authored velocity -> ANGLE-mode stick loop. The connectome never outputs sticks in Stage A.
stageAOutput.laterStage: direct four-channel stick output is CP7

limitations: Eye directions are a regular-lattice approximation: data-derived orientation, declared deltaPhi and anchors; not a measured eye map (upgrade: register Zhao et al. microCT eye map).
Five upper-front depth cells have no eye coverage under this approximation.
Mechanosensory channel encodings are declared analogues, not identified neural codes.
Goal and previous-action channels are non-biological inputs.
